)

0x6

Available via
FrTSyn.h
⌋
[SWS_FrTSyn_00152]

⌈The function FrTSyn_IcvVerificationIndication shall inform the Det, if de-
velopment error detection is enabled (FrTSynDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE) and
if the function call has failed because of the following reasons:
• jobId is invalid (FRTSYN_E_PARAM)
